title: A THEORETICAL APPROACH TO CHARACTERIZE THE ACCURACY-FAIRNESS TRADE-OFF PARETO FRONTIER
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical and theoretical characterization of the accuracy-fairness trade-off (FairFrontier) in machine learning. While fairness is an ethical principle, the paper provides a formal analysis and numerical examples using synthetic data to define properties like continuity and sharp declines in accuracy, rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
